intents.name: BUY
intents.desc: Buy new units from the catalog for a concrete assignment (max 3 entries per reply, total cost within war.supplies). Every entry names the order its units get when they arrive (command + target or pos): units are not bought to idle at the base. Idle squads at the base are stood down after war.mode.params.idleDespawnMin minutes and refunded.

params.name: command
params.hint: REQUIRED assignment of the new units: MOVE, ATTACK, DEFEND or RECON (they get this order the moment they are ready; nothing is bought to wait at the base)

params.name: target
params.hint: objective id from the situation for that order

intents.name: OFFER_MISSION
intents.desc: Offer up to 3 missions to a human-led squad (humanLed=true): each offer has kind CAPTURE|DEFEND|RECON|DESTROY, a target (objective id) or pos [x, z], and a brief (max 240 chars, in the voice of HQ). Skip squads whose mission.state is accepted.

params.name: squad
params.hint: human-led squad id from the situation

intents.name: ESTABLISH_FOB
intents.desc: Establish a forward operating base (FOB) at a candidate site: pays the FOB cost, a transport with an escort drives out and builds it. A FOB gives a spawn point, a command post, a supply cache and an arsenal near the front. Only one FOB may be in progress per side, max war.mode.params.fobMax per side. Choose a site from fobSites; check fobRules for the cost and your supplies.

params.name: site
params.hint: site id from fobSites in the situation

intents.name: UPGRADE_FOB
intents.desc: Add a vehicle depot to an active FOB (tier 2) for half the FOB cost (fobRules.upgradeCost).

params.name: fob
params.hint: id of an active FOB (state active, tier 1) from fobs in the situation

intents.name: RESUPPLY
intents.desc: Send a supply truck convoy from the HQ to a FOB: the cargo is added to the FOB stock on arrival.

params.name: fob
params.hint: id of an active FOB from fobs in the situation

intents.name: CONVOY
intents.desc: Move supply stock between two bases with a truck convoy.

params.name: origin
params.hint: origin base id (HQ or a FOB id)

intents.name: REQUEST_VEHICLE
intents.desc: A player asks for a vehicle at his position.

intents.name: REQUEST_BACKUP

intents.name: REPORT_CONTACT
